Upstream content is submitted and maintained as Markdown, and the live FastAPI source confirms the retained content version (https://github.com/andrewyng/context-hub/blob/67dcbeb2eb42c808549f08397920ad58be7c2206/content/fastapi/docs/package/python/DOC.md).
deviations_from_upstream.fix: Extend the documented search/get workflow to refresh the registry with chub update --force when needed, inspect the returned content version, and use current primary documentation when it does not cover the required dependency version. Submit or build an updated curated document separately; neither registry refresh nor downloading the existing bundle guarantees new content.

deviations_from_upstream.what: The stack deliberately uses the CLI instead of registering the optional packaged MCP server.
deviations_from_upstream.why: The adopted on-demand lane is documented in recipes/README.md and docs/token-session-handbook.md; the reviewed client templates/config contain no registration. CLI-only operation is supported upstream, so this is a selection of interface rather than a missing requirement.
deviations_from_upstream.fix: Keep the CLI lane documented. If MCP is later selected, use the installed chub-mcp path or link it deliberately, register it explicitly, and qualify search/get through the actual client before claiming MCP coverage.
